name: rise_of_the_dark_realms_takes_every_creature_card_from_both_graveyards_under_its_casters_control
notes: Printed: 'Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.' Seat 0 casts Rise of the Dark Realms ({7}{B}{B}) with a creature card and an instant in its own graveyard and a creature card and an artifact (non-creature) card in seat 1's graveyard. Both creature cards go onto the battlefield and BOTH are controlled by seat 0 (the caster), including the one seat 1 owns; the two non-creature cards stay in their graveyards, and Rise itself goes to seat 0's graveyard (no creature card). Nothing else moves: seat 0's hand keeps its spare creature card.
